note: Automation prepared this file and must not fill it in. Audible quality is a human judgement. Replace each AWAITING_OWNER_INPUT with true, false, or a short note.

phrases.english: Hello Ajay. SaathiOS voice output is working correctly.
phrases.nepali: नमस्ते अजय। साथी ओएसको आवाज परीक्षण भइरहेको छ।
phrases.mixed: SaathiOS अहिले local private alpha mode मा चलिरहेको छ।

nepali_audible_or_safe_fallback.check: Nepali is audible, or a clear fallback is shown (silence is a defect)

stop_halts_speech.check: Stop halts speech immediately, not at end of sentence

replay_does_not_overlap.check: Replay does not overlap the previous playback

new_response_cancels_old_speech.check: A new response cancels the old speech

route_change_stops_speech.check: Navigating to another page stops speech

microphone_indicator_accurate.check: The browser microphone indicator matches the app's state

microphone_stops_and_releases.check: Stopping the mic releases it (browser indicator goes out)

no_hidden_recording.check: No recording happens without a visible indicator

microphone_start_interrupts_output.check: Pressing the mic while audio plays stops the audio first (VOICE_INPUT_INTERRUPTS_OUTPUT)

volume_acceptable.check: Volume is comfortable at normal system volume

persona_label_correct.check: Persona name and avatar are correct and consistent

surface_tested.check: Which voice surface did you test — platform voice runtime, or chat VoiceControl? They differ; see VOICE_INTERRUPTION_DECISION.json.
